g.text: The scope rule on K[q, i] = exp(-(Xq[q, j] - Xs[i, j]) ** 2 / Var)
, the root of the right side
the sum over j sits here
its base is not a candidate
The spine extends from exp(…) to this product
and stops here: the product has two factors
that are not constant. scope(j) is on the
spine, so the operator of the equation,
a candidate node of the scope rule
the bold border of scope(j): the deepest candidate that holds every occurrence of j
a node that is not a candidate
an access to an input tensor
